text:
maya: Heads-up — telemetry volume from spans is spiking because we're shipping high-cardinality attrs (prompt_text, user_id, request_id) to Honeycomb. Cost and retention are starting to explode.

jake: ugh. saw that in dashboards this morning. span count up 3x after the new chat rollout.

sophia: can you paste an example span payload? are prompts in attributes or the body?

maya: example: {trace_id:..., span_name: 'model.request', attributes: {prompt: 'user prompt...', prompt_length: 512, user_id: 'u_123456', request_id: 'r_abcde'}} — prompts are in attributes.

eli: security concern too — prompt_text can contain PII. we should stop shipping raw prompts immediately. recommend scrubbing + hashing with HMAC + salt.

jake: agree on removing prompt_text. proposal: transform processor in otel collector to drop prompt attribute, add prompt_hash = sha256(salt + prompt) truncated to 16 hex chars. deterministic so we can correlate but not leak content.

maya: +1. two follow-ups: 1) where do we store salt and rotate? 2) what about user_id and request_id cardinality?

sophia: for salt, use KMS-stored secret (kms://projects/redwood/telemetry-salt), rotate monthly. transform processor does HMAC with that key via a sidecar service or collector plugin.

eli: rotation needs a key-id scheme so old hashes can be recognized for correlation during overlap window. keep at least 2 keys active. document key rotation policy.

jake: request_id: we need request ids for debugging short-lived incidents. propose keep full request_id on spans for 1 hour, then cull to truncated hash for longer retention. we can implement time-windowed exporter rules.

sophia: implement retention tiers: full-attr spans retained 7 days, aggregated/hashed spans 90 days. metrics stay 180 days. dashboards should default to hashed view beyond 7 days.

maya: how do we implement in OTEL collector? sample patch idea:

```
processors:
  transform:
    actions:
      - match: "attributes.prompt"
        action: "delete"
      - match: "attributes.prompt"
        action: "insert"
        value_from: "hmac_sha256(kms://telemetry-salt, attributes.prompt) | truncate(16)"
      - match: "attributes.user_id"
        action: "hash"
        algorithm: "hmac_sha256"
        truncate: 12
      - match: "attributes.request_id"
        action: "conditional_keep"
        keep_if_age_lt: 3600  # seconds
```

ops-bot: noted: created infra ticket INF-2149 to add collector transform + KMS integration.

eli: also block including raw prompt in any exporter (OTLP, Jaeger, Datadog, Honeycomb). add CI lint that rejects code which adds prompt to span attributes.

jake: +1 on CI lint. we can add a grep in pre-commit for "span.set_attribute('prompt'" and fail builds.

sophia: dashboard UX: add a toggle in Console to show "anonymized telemetry" vs "raw" for owners with proper access. but by default non-admins see hashed/anonymized. add clear banner that older data is hashed/aggregated.

maya: rollout plan: 1) patch collector in staging with transforms 2) run for 48h, validate alerts and debugging flows 3) deploy to prod with 10% sampling off full-attr spans for first 24h 4) enable retention rules in vendor (Honeycomb) to expire raw attributes after 7 days.

jake: I'll prepare the collector patch and the pre-commit lint. eli, can you sign-off on the HMAC/key rotation design?

eli: will review. also add a privacy review doc for legal.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging started for collector-config v2026.03.18-07:15 (patch: telemetry-transform).

maya: action items: @jake collector patch + lint (due EOD), @sophia console banner + toggle mockups (due Wed), @eli KMS rotation doc (due Tue). I'll own rollout coordination.

sophia: one more thought: store prompt_length and model_name (low-cardinality) so we can still slice performance without content.

jake: done — will keep prompt_length and model_name, drop raw prompt.

maya: thanks all. if anyone finds a span with raw prompt after prod rollout ping me and we'll revert exporters immediately. :thumbsup:
